title: ngc attempts to generate metadata for rxjs Subscription in 6.0.0

labels.name: hotlist: components team
labels.description: Related to Angular CDK or Angular Material

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Indicates than the issue relates to something that worked in a previous version

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

body:
### Steps to reproduce
1. Clone https://github.com/jelbourn/material2/tree/angular6-dep
2. `npm i`
3. `./node_modules/.bin/ngc -p ./src/cdk/collections/tsconfig-build.json`

[Relevant tsconfig](https://github.com/jelbourn/material2/blob/angular6-dep/src/cdk/collections/tsconfig-build.json)

It's also worth mentioning that the bazel build / tests for this are fine.

### Error
